summary: Flutter's shared error banner exposes SemanticsRole.alert for workspace errors in TEXT, DM and voice. Android also adds a separate polite live-region child because its accessibility bridge does not map alert role to live-region behavior. This improves TalkBack announcement semantics but does not prove spoken timing or parity with web's assertive urgency.

checks.name: Flutter text error alert-role regression reproduced before implementation
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'exposes text conversation errors with alert semantics'
checks.observation: Before the fix, the text error remained visible but exposed SemanticsRole.none instead of SemanticsRole.alert.

checks.name: Focused text error alert role
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'exposes text conversation errors with alert semantics'
checks.observation: The visible text history error is exposed with SemanticsRole.alert. This assertion checks the semantics tree, not an actual spoken announcement.

checks.name: Android error live-region regression
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/workspace_screen_test.dart --plain-name 'exposes Android conversation errors as polite live regions'
checks.observation: The Android target semantics tree retains the parent alert role and exposes the message text as a separate polite live region. The test first failed before implementation. This is not a TalkBack runtime test.

checks.name: Workspace screen widget tests
checks.observation: All workspace screen widget tests pass, including prejoin status, alert role and Android live-region regressions.

checks.name: Full Flutter test suite and analyzer
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub && flutter analyze --no-pub
checks.observation: All 289 Flutter tests pass and flutter analyze reports no issues.

checks.name: Native accessibility bridge mapping inspection
checks.observation: Flutter Windows engine maps alert events to the native alert event, and macOS converts alert events into live-region notifications. The Android bridge currently has an ALERT role enum but does not configure alert nodes as live regions; this source inspection does not replace device acceptance.

checks.name: GitVerse Windows CI for alert-role change
checks.observation: The workflow is configured for pushes that modify desktop/**. The accessible GitVerse CI page was signed out and its latest visible run was #1690402 for f85f718, before this source revision; Windows test/analyzer/Release results for this change could not be verified.

checks.name: Native screen-reader announcement priority and timing
checks.observation: Widget semantics were checked, but actual spoken timing/priority was not checked. Android uses a polite live-region child as a fallback; its TalkBack delivery and urgency remain unverified.

checks.name: Android debug APK build
checks.observation: The Android debug APK target builds with the Android-only polite live-region fallback. Existing Flutter plugin Kotlin Gradle Plugin migration warnings were emitted.

checks.name: macOS debug application build
checks.observation: The macOS Debug application target builds with SemanticsRole.alert. This verifies compilation, not VoiceOver behavior.

remaining: Verify actual spoken announcement timing/priority and focus through TalkBack on Android, VoiceOver on macOS and NVDA on Windows. Android currently has a polite fallback; confirm whether this sufficiently communicates workspace errors and whether an assertive native bridge is required to match web urgency.
